title: Ron Tototz at the Cholon pool
description: Ron Tototz stands in swim trunks on the patterned tile deck of the French swimming pool in Cholon, the Chinese district of Saigon. Behind him a door carries FIRST AID and PRIVATE KEEP OUT signs; an older, tanned man — "just a person there," per Larry — reads in an aluminum lawn chair at right. Same visit as VN-0005.
larrysRecollection: Ronnie Tototz standing at swimming pool in Cholon
researchNotes: Identification relayed by Larry's son from Larry's dictation (2026-08-15 session; archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0004-c18035138.json). The place — the French swimming pool in Cholon — comes from Larry's fuller comment on VN-0005, the companion frame. The standing man matches the recurring dark-haired soldier of VN-0001/VN-0002, consistent with the Ron identification in those frames.
